sentences.en: Please restrict your orders to what is in our catalog.
sentences.zh: 请限制您的订单只在我们的目录中选择。

sentences.en: The new law restricts the sale of cigarettes to minors.
sentences.zh: 新法律将香烟的销售限制在未成年人身上。

sentences.en: But today smoking in public places is forbidden or strictly restricted.
sentences.zh: 但如今，在公共场所吸烟被禁止或严格限制。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：re+strict（严格的）→严格限制→限制
